title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11161)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_11161) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11161). This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) which is identical with ISO 491 6 : 1991 Textiles — Seam types — Classification and terminology' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the Garments ) Sectional Committee and approval of the Textile Division Council. Indian Standard was based on corresponding International Standard ISO 491 6: 1982 which has since been revised to ISO 4916: 1991. Accordingly, IS 11161 has been revised to align it with ISO 4916 : 1991. The text of ISO Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is particularly drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. b) Comma (,) has been used as a decimal marker in the International Standard, while in Indian Standards, the current practice is

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
